pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā sattarasavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pahāraṃ denti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.6: ime āvuso chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā amhākaṃ pahāraṃ dentīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā bhikkhūnaṃ pahāraṃ dassantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.9: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave kupitā . . . dethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.12: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā kupitā . . . dassatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.13: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.15.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa kupito anattamano pahāraṃ dadeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:2.1.10: kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā nissaggiyena vā antamaso uppalapattena pi pahāraṃ deti, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:2.2.1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī kupito anattamano pahāraṃ deti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:2.2.4: anupasampannassa kupito anattamano pahāraṃ deti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
